name: B10-0122/2025 (PPE) – Continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Nigeria to act. It calls for the immediate release of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu, a singer sentenced to death for blasphemy over a song, and warns he could be sentenced again. It asks Nigeria to drop its blasphemy laws, which it says break the country's own constitution and international human rights promises, and to abolish the death penalty.

- No law changes; Parliament only urges Nigeria to release Sharif-Aminu and repeal blasphemy laws.
- Affects people charged with blasphemy in Nigeria, including Sharif-Aminu, Rhoda Jatau and Mubarak Bala.
- Next: Nigeria's Supreme Court is asked to prioritise his case; Nigeria is asked to ratify a death penalty treaty.
